result.title: The Best Optimizer Depends on Batch Size
result.summary: A plethora of new adaptive optimizers are designed to efficiently estimate and use minibatch gradient statistics to shape parameter updates, but they are typically benchmarked at a single batch size. Hyperparameter scaling rules promise to preserve performance as batch size and gradient noise change, suggesting that the best optimizer at one batch size should remain the best at another. We challenge this approach to developing and evaluating optimizers by showing: (1) no principled scaling rule for Muon works consistently across training settings, and (2) the best optimizer for language model pretraining changes with batch size even after extensive hyperparameter tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文质疑自适应优化器的超参数缩放规则，指出 Muon 缺乏一致缩放规则，且语言模型预训练中最优优化器会随 batch size 变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 材料仅涉及优化器与 batch size 缩放，未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，缺少与 LVR 主线的实质联系，也无具体可迁移的方法线索。
